headline: Italian Banking and Industrial Contract Negotiations Reach Deadlock
summary: Talks between Italian banking association ABI and sector unions over collective contract renewals have stalled over wage demands. Across Italy, major labor agreements covering millions of workers in retail, automotive, and graphics expire near year-end.
why: National collective bargaining agreements determine wage floors and employment terms across major sectors in Italy.

impacts.name: Italy
impacts.why: Stalled labor negotiations across banking and retail risk industrial action and wage pressure.
